::: {.justify}

I am an FY4 doctor currently working in intensive care in
London. I’ll be moving to ED next year and ultimately plan
on training in anaesthetics. I would also like to do more
voluntary work in the future, having done some in Bulgaria
last year. 

I am particularly interested in day case surgery, which I
have worked to promote from both anaesthetic and surgical
perspectives, and pain management, which was the subject of
my PGCert. I care about anything that will improve my
patients’ experiences, though, and am always involved in
quality improvement. 


:::
